I’m interested in how mathematics and statistics help us understand uncertainty in financial systems. This journal brings together notes from coursework, computational projects and independent study.

My academic background includes the Master’s program in Modélisation Aléatoire et Finance Quantitative (M2MO) at Université Paris Cité and studies in financial risk management at ENSAI.

:::

:::

## Areas of interest

I write about probability, stochastic processes, numerical methods and their applications to pricing, calibration and risk. The [topic index](topics.qmd) brings together work on these subjects.
